convergence_report.convergence_notes: All risk and return metrics demonstrated checkpoint stability at N=1000. Tail sample size: 50 observations below 5th percentile. Finite sample stability across checkpoints does not establish asymptotic convergence; tail risk estimates remain subject to finite sample variation.
limitations: Finite sample checkpoint stability across sequential sample sizes does not establish asymptotic mathematical convergence; tail risk estimates remain subject to finite sample variation.
At N=1000, tail sample size is 50 observations below the 5th percentile, which provides limited statistical precision for CVaR (Expected Shortfall) estimation.
